outputs.explanation: Panel A includes bar graphs quantifying HMGB1 band intensity (nuclear, cytosolic, mitochondrial fractions) presented as mean ± SD with error bars (N=4), but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B is an immunoelectron micrograph showing gold-silver particle staining; it is not a plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C is a western blot showing HMGB1 detection across differently purified mitochondrial/cytosolic/nuclear fractions; it contains no quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a western blot showing proteinase K protection assay results; it contains no averaged quantification plot, so individual data points are not applicable.
